name: MQTT integration (standard mqtt in/out nodes)
info:
AlarmSystemUltimate has NO built-in MQTT. This example wires it to a broker using Node-RED's standard `mqtt in` / `mqtt out` nodes.

First: open the `mqtt-broker` config node and set your broker host/port/credentials.

INPUT — Zone sensors (MQTT -> Alarm)
- `mqtt in` subscribes to `home/sensors/#`.
- A Function normalizes the payload to a boolean (true = zone open/active) and keeps `msg.topic` (the MQTT topic).
- The Alarm matches `msg.topic` against each zone `topic`. In this example the zones use:
    - home/sensors/front_door
    - home/sensors/living_pir
  So the sensor's MQTT topic must equal the zone topic.
- Publish e.g.  topic `home/sensors/front_door`  payload `ON` / `OFF` (or `true`/`false`, `open`/`closed`, `1`/`0`).

INPUT — Commands (MQTT -> Alarm)
- `mqtt in` subscribes to `home/alarm/cmd`.
- A Function sets `msg.topic = "alarm"` (the controlTopic) and builds the control message.
- Publish to `home/alarm/cmd` either a plain string  (`arm`, `disarm`, `status`, `panic`, `siren_on`, `siren_off`, `bypass`, `reset`)
  or a JSON object, e.g.  {"command":"disarm","code":"1234"}  or  {"command":"bypass","zoneTopic":"home/sensors/living_pir"}.

OUTPUT — Alarm -> MQTT
- Output 0 (All messages) -> publishes the full event JSON to `home/alarm/event`,
  and a Function publishes the current `mode` (retained) to `home/alarm/state`.
- Output 1 (Siren) -> publishes to `home/alarm/siren`.

The `controlTopic` is `alarm` (configurable on the node). Output topics like `alarm/event` / `alarm/siren` are produced by the node and here re-mapped onto the `home/alarm/...` MQTT namespace.
